slots.jd.community-hospital.about:
Summary
Pinebrook Medical Center is a community hospital in Toledo, OH. Our mission is to provide safe, compassionate care close to home for every patient who comes through our doors. We are seeking a Graduate Registered Nurse to join our on-site nursing team and grow with experienced colleagues. A current registered nurse licence and a Basic Life Support Card are required for this position.
slots.jd.community-hospital.duties:
Duties
- Assess patients on admission and throughout each shift, recording findings in the patient record
- Coordinate with physicians and the wider care team on treatment plans and changes in patient condition
- Give medications as ordered, checking each dose, route and time before administration
- Monitor vital signs and escalate concerns promptly to the charge nurse or physician
- Take part in bedside handoff so incoming staff have a clear picture of each patient
- Teach patients and families about their care, medications and discharge instructions
slots.jd.community-hospital.needs:
Licensure and qualifications
- 2 or more years of experience as a registered nurse
- Patient assessment and vital signs monitoring skills in a hospital or clinic setting
- Working knowledge of care planning and triage
- Accurate clinical documentation and consistent infection control practice
- Current registered nurse licence and Basic Life Support Card required; Advanced Cardiac Life Support Card preferred
slots.r1.b1: Charts care planning notes in the clinic record after each patient visit, reducing documentation gaps by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Reports vital signs monitoring trends during shift handoff so incoming nurses can act quickly on changes in patient condition.
slots.r1.b3: Completes patient assessment before giving medications, reducing medication timing errors by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Coordinates with physicians on discharge planning, confirming orders and follow-up instructions before patients leave the clinic.
slots.r1.i1: Provides direct patient care at Harborview Community Clinic, keeping charting in the patient record accurate and current after each visit.
slots.r1.i2: Supports patients at Harborview Community Clinic by giving medications as ordered and checking each dose against the patient record.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level registered nurse with about 2 years of experience providing patient care under close supervision on a defined share of the unit's work. Skilled in bedside handoff, vital signs monitoring and care planning, with a B.S.N. from Lakeshore University.
slots.summary.2: Graduate registered nurse with about 2 years of experience working alongside a supervising nurse on a small portion of daily patient care. Contributes through bedside handoff, vital signs monitoring and care planning, and holds a current Basic Life Support Card.
